rows.en: No, there should've been two more of you...
Hold on, there were two more of you, right?
Huh? There were two more of you, weren't there...?
Hey! Weren't there two more of you guys?
Weren't there two more of you?
Oh, you mean these two.
...They're 00 Gundam and Wing Gundam Zero.
I am Wing Zero...
Don't take it personally. The word 'friendly' just isn't in these two's dictionary...
They don't talk much, but they're good guys. Treat them well for me.
...Are you a Gundam too?
Yeah, I'm Nu Gundam. I'm counting on you.
I'm Zeta Gundam. Good to meet you.
Without a doubt, you're a Gundam too.
Yeah. This world needs Gundams.
By the way, what is this Celestial Being?
By the way, what is this Celestial Being?
By the way, what exactly is this Celestial Being?
By the way, what's this Celestial Being?
By the way, what is Celestial Being, exactly?
So what's this Celestial Being, anyway?
So what's this Celestial Being, anyway?
It's the armed organization we belong to. We're fighting the enemy that rules the Desert Cube.
The Desert Cube...? So that's the name of this Cube.
The Desert Cube...? So that's the name of this Cube...
The Desert Cube...? Is that the name of this Cube?
The Desert Cube...? So that's the name of this Cube.
The Desert Cube...? So that's the name of this Cube...
The Desert Cube...? That's what this Cube's called, huh?
The Desert Cube...? So that's the name of this Cube.
Yeah, that's right. ...Hm? Wait, did you guys come from a different Cube?
No way...!? You don't even know about the Gaia Cubes?
Simply put, a Gaia Cube is this world.
This place is a desert, it's in ruins, it's a shitty world, but apparently there are other Cubes too.
Not that I know what kind of worlds those are.
...That's probably right.
We came from a place called the Begins Cube.
...Yes, probably.
We were in a place called the Begins Cube, after all.
...Yes, I think that's probably right.
We were in a place called the Begins Cube, after all.
...You're probably right.
We were in a place called the Begins Cube, after all.
...Yeah, I think so.
We were in a place called the Begins Cube, after all.
Yeah! Guess that's how it is!!
We were in this place called the Begins Cube.
...Probably, yeah.
We came from a place called the Begins Cube.
I see... Mind telling me more about that?
Sorry to break up the party, but it's dangerous to talk long out here. Let's move somewhere else.
Right... Okay, let's continue this at our camp.
Fine. We've still got things to ask you, too.
Understood. We've still got a mountain of questions for you, too.
Understood. There's still a lot we'd like to ask you as well.
All right. We still have plenty we want to ask, too.
Got it. We still have things we want to ask you, too.
Yeah, sure. Hope they've got some good coffee there, eh? Eh?
Count me in. We've still got things to ask you, too.
{8074} and the others moved to Celestial Being's camp.
A combat force built around Gundams stood ready there, making it look every bit like a forward base.
Hey, welcome back, everyone.
Well, duh! A mission like that's a piece of cake!
You were later than planned, so I was starting to worry.
Ah, sorry about that.
Couldn't be helped. Team Trinity showed up.
What...!? I see... So they've finally come this close...
Yeah, that's right. And they brought a whole horde of their mobile dolls along.
That's bad. We'll have to rethink our strategy, too...
...By the way, who are they?
Oh, I should've introduced them sooner. We saved them while they were under attack by the enemy.
Mind you, they're pretty handy in a fight, y'know?
I see. I'm Gundam Sandrock. I specialize in localized warfare. Nice to meet you.
I'm Seravee Gundam.
If you don't mind, I'd like to hear your story in detail, too.
Of course. Then we'll call our comrades over from our base, too.
Of course. Then let's call our friends over from our base, too.

notes.note: 0.163-0.169, 0.195-0.201, 0.205-0.211, 0.217-0.230, 0.236-0.242, 0.269-0.270 are party-leader variants (7 leaders, no labels). Order inferred from content: Zero, a Gundam (Nu/Zeta), Mebius, W, OOO, Den-O (Momotaros), the other Gundam. Each line voiced from its own wording.
No speaker recovered; Cherudim, who introduces 00 and Wing Zero in the next lines.
Cherudim uses the full machine names (00 Gundam, Wing Gundam Zero); kept full names here, short forms (00, Wing Zero) in their own replies.
Source word is an odd compound, almost certainly a typo/mis-decode for 'aiso' (friendliness/sociability), given the next line 'they don't talk much'. Translated as 'friendly'.
Yoroshiku tanomu direction: Cherudim asks the heroes to treat the two well -> 'Treat them well for me.' 0.182 Nu Gundam's tanomu kept speaker-asks-listener: 'I'm counting on you.'
Wing Zero agrees with 00's 'you're a Gundam too' (said to Nu/Zeta): 'This world needs Gundams.'
Source sets Desert Cube / Begins Cube in brackets; written without quotes, matching earlier slices (Team Trinity, Begins Cube).
0.213-0.216 have no speaker; read as Cherudim continuing (possibly Deathscythe Hell, given the crude 0.215). 'Kuso mitee' kept as 'shitty'.
Leader-4 (W) variant uses 'boku', so it is Philip's voice; kept plain and calm.
Momotaros variant: hopes for good coffee (his Milk Dipper habit); repeated 'naa?' rendered 'eh? Eh?'.
No speaker recovered; brash 'piece of cake' fits Deathscythe Hell (Duo), who apologises two rows later. It answers a line not in this slice (probably a skipped branch).
Slice ends mid-beat; 0.270 is leader 2's variant of Zero's 0.269.

report: All rows translated. Leader-variant blocks voiced from content (no labels). 0.178 likely typo for 'aiso' -> 'friendly'. 0.171, 0.213-0.216, 0.249 speakers inferred (Cherudim / Duo). No new names.
